description: The image displays two side-by-side vertical bar charts illustrating Fleiss Kappa values across different ambiguity metrics. In the left chart, the horizontal category axis features a blurred label that appears to read "Ambiguity Std" and contains the discrete categories 0.0, 0.47, 0.82, and 0.94. Its vertical value axis is labeled "Fleiss Kappa" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8 with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.2. The left chart contains four bars rendered in varying shades of blue, each annotated with its exact numerical value on top. The tallest bar, corresponding to category 0.0, is dark blue and has a value of 0.88, while the shortest bar, at category 0.82, is the lightest blue and has a value of 0.03; the remaining bars are category 0.47 with a value of 0.46 and category 0.94 with a value of 0.24. In the right chart, the horizontal category axis is labeled "Max Ambiguity" and includes the sequential categories 1, 2, and 3. Its vertical value axis is identical to the left chart, labeled "Fleiss Kappa" with a linear scale from 0.0 to 0.8 and tick intervals of 0.2. The right chart displays three bars, also colored in progressively lighter shades of blue from left to right and annotated with exact values, which are sorted in descending order of height. The tallest bar, labeled 1, is dark blue with a value of 0.89, followed by the medium blue bar for category 2 at 0.46, and the shortest bar, labeled 3, is light blue with a value of 0.23.
